title: urochilus sanguineus
intro: Urochilus sanguineus, commonly known as Red Ghost Flower, is a plant species from the family Apocynaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, potentially aiding in pain relief and wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Urochilus sanguineus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, which are believed to exhibit sedative and analgesic effects, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its antioxidant properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of this plant for human consumption.
